name: Shimmer Ridge
summary: Frostmane trolls hold Shimmer Ridge in northern Dun Morogh, west of the Gates of Ironforge. Its two camps span a chasm, and the ridge is the only place shimmerweed grows.

sections.title: A Frostmane Stronghold
sections.body: Frostmane trolls hold the high ground west of Ironforge's gates. Two camps sit on opposite sides of a chasm, joined by a wooden bridge. Troll scavengers and their tamed mountain boars guard the camps. The ridge lies near the main road and the dwarven capital, so travelers and mountain patrols face raids from above.

sections.title: The Price of Shimmerweed
sections.body: Frostmane trolls grow shimmerweed on the ridge. Dwarven brewmasters prize the plant for potent, flavorful highland ales, and it cannot easily be gathered elsewhere. Mountaineers and young recruits brave troll ambushes and tusked beasts to gather it from the trolls' plots.

faq.answer: Shimmer Ridge lies in northern Dun Morogh, west of the Gates of Ironforge, which lead into the dwarven capital.
Frostmane trolls control Shimmer Ridge. They guard two camps joined by a bridge, with tamed mountain boars.

faq.q: What is shimmerweed and why is it sought after?
faq.answer: Shimmerweed is a mountain herb that grows on Shimmer Ridge. Local dwarven brewers value it for making flavorful highland ale.

faq.q: Why don't the dwarves clear out the trolls completely?
faq.answer: Ironforge's military is occupied with broader defense and external matters, so regional mountaineers and wandering recruits handle local threats like the Frostmane camps in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the Frostmane threat from Ironforge's gates, and Shimmer Ridge is a dangerous source of shimmerweed for dwarven stout.
As an herbalist, you can gather shimmerweed on Shimmer Ridge, where Frostmane trolls tend it among their camps.
